description: Price-action formations (candlesticks valid only when paired with these or S/R / Fib)

formations.name: Rising wedge
formations.notes: Converging higher highs and higher lows into apex — often breaks down

formations.name: Falling wedge
formations.notes: Converging lower highs and lower lows — often breaks up

formations.name: Symmetrical triangle
formations.notes: Converging highs and lows — direction from prior trend

formations.name: Bull flag
formations.notes: Sharp rally then tight downward channel

formations.name: Bear flag
formations.notes: Sharp drop then tight upward channel

formations.name: Double bottom
formations.notes: Two similar lows with neckline break potential

formations.name: Double top
formations.notes: Two similar highs with neckline break potential
